name: Vicious Spells
notes: Cut from HoH1: both Vicious Cuts levels carry a commented-out second trigger on skill hits (hitspell) that takes 5% of the target's current health, at 2% (level 1) and 5% (level 2) chance. HoH1 shipped only the Twin Daggers trigger (5% and 10%). Numbers are HoH1's, not this port's.
summary: Skill hits can also cut 5% of the target's current health: a 2% chance, then 5%.
